# רהיטים סימפל | Simple Design — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A young, modern, and dynamic furniture brand from Tel Aviv that combines contemporary style with smart pricing and a simple, fast shopping experience. The brand exudes confidence and energy with a light, non-heavy approach - like an Instagram/TikTok lifestyle brand. It features clean minimalist aesthetics with beige, black, white, and natural wood tones, targeting young couples and families (25-45) who want modern design without luxury prices.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About רהיטים סימפל | Simple Design
A young, modern, and dynamic furniture brand from Tel Aviv that combines contemporary style with smart pricing and a simple, fast shopping experience. The brand exudes confidence and energy with a light, non-heavy approach - like an Instagram/TikTok lifestyle brand. It features clean minimalist aesthetics with beige, black, white, and natural wood tones, targeting young couples and families (25-45) who want modern design without luxury prices.

## Target Audience
זוגות צעירים, משפחות בתחילת דרך, שוכרי דירות, גילאי 25-45

## Industry
ריהוט ועיצוב פנים
